subject: Operator reassignment notice for EdgeCache cluster -- mapping request & evidence
messages:
From: Infra Ops <infra-ops@edgecloud.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: operator reassignment for EdgeCache cluster (us-west-2)

Hi Connor / Redwood team,

We're writing to inform you of a planned operator reassignment that affects the EdgeCache cluster backing your us-west-2 tenancy. As part of our regular provider consolidation, the operator currently managing your nodes (Nebula Operators LLC) will be rotated to a new operator (Nimbus Node Services) on 2027-06-15.

High-level impact:
- Data plane operator personnel will change; no planned downtime for normal traffic.
- A subset of operator-managed maintenance windows will shift to a new cadence.
- Operator access to logs/monitoring will be provisioned under Nimbus accounts; credentials and onboarding will be completed via our partner portal.

We realize this is effectively a subprocessor change for you. Attached is our formal change notice (edgecloud-operator-change-notice.pdf) and a SOC 2 snapshot for Nimbus (edgecloud-soc2-snapshot.zip).

Requested actions from Redwood:
1) Confirm whether Redwood requires an updated subprocessor mapping file and if additional evidence (e.g., contract addendum or CAIQ answers) is needed.
2) If you have regional restrictions or non-delegation requirements, let us know by 2027-06-01 so we can pause the reassignment for your tenancy.

Point of contact for the change: Sanjay Rao (infra-ops@edgecloud.io).

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Infra Ops, EdgeCloud Networks

--
attachment: edgecloud-operator-change-notice.pdf (application/pdf)
attachment: edgecloud-soc2-snapshot.zip (application/zip)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Infra Ops <infra-ops@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: operator reassignment for EdgeCache cluster (us-west-2)

Thanks Sanjay — quick clarifying questions so we can advise our security/compliance reviewers: 

1) Can you provide a one-page operator responsibilities matrix that lists access types (SSH, API keys, monitoring read vs write), personnel background checks, and SCIM/team membership boundaries for Nimbus?
2) We need to confirm whether any customer data (logs or persisted KV shards) will be handled by the new operator before/after cutover — please confirm storage ownership and retention safeguards.
3) Please share the exact mapping for fallbacks: if Nimbus cannot service a node, which operator or region will take over (we ask for explicit operator name / account id).

For tracking, please upload the operator responsibilities matrix and a short fallback matrix as an XLSX to the HubSpot deal and share the link — we will attach those to our RFI evidence pack.

If the reassignment will introduce any new subcontractors (i.e., Nimbus relying on a downstream operator), list those parties and provide CAIQ responses or SOC2 evidence.

We'd also like to loop in our procurement/legal team early if there will be changes to contractual terms for operator access.

Connor
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
attachment: redwood-fallback-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@edgecloud.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marketplace Admin <marketplace@edgecloud.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: operator reassignment for EdgeCache cluster (us-west-2)

Connor — thanks for the speedy reply. Attached is the operator responsibilities one-pager and our fallback matrix. Summary answers inline below.

1) Access and responsibilities:
- SSH: no persistent SSH access for operator; ephemeral jump-box terminal sessions logged via our bastion and rotated keys.
- API keys: managed by EdgeCloud platform, scoped to operator tenant IDs; Nimbus will be provisioned separate operator credentials.
- Monitoring: read-only Prometheus endpoints for operator support; write access limited to alert acknowledgement events.
- Personnel checks: Nimbus provides background check attestations for core ops team (attached SOC2 snapshot covers MSA scope).

2) Data handling:
- No customer KV shards will be transferred to Nimbus; storage remains controlled by EdgeCloud storage service. Operators are responsible for node-level maintenance and ephemeral caches only. Logs are accessible per our logging access policy; persistent storage ownership remains EdgeCloud.

3) Fallback mapping:
- Primary: Nimbus Node Services (operator account OP-NIM-442)
- Secondary fallback: Beacon Operators (operator account OP-BEC-117) — Beacon will take over in failover scenarios; they are already approved for US-west.

Attachments uploaded to HubSpot deal HC-9821 and shared drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleFallbackPlan

If Redwood requires vendor addenda or an explicit subprocessor signature, send procurement contact and we'll initiate a marketplace addendum flow.

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Infra Ops, EdgeCloud Networks

--
attachment: operator-responsibilities-onepager.pdf (application/pdf)
attachment: fallback-matrix-nimbus-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 20:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: operator reassignment for EdgeCache cluster (us-west-2)

Sanjay — appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachments. We're going to run these through our security intake checklist and validate the fallback operator (Beacon Operators) evidence. A few next steps on our side: 

- Laura will confirm whether we need a legal addendum (laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com) by 2027-05-28.
- Ben will validate the SOC2 snapshot and personnel attestations and return any open items by 2027-05-27.
- If either of those raise escalation items, we'll let you know and request a short delay to the reassignment for our tenancy.

Assuming no escalations, we expect to accept the reassignment and will confirm by 2027-06-01. Please keep the HubSpot and shared drive links current.

Connor
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
